name: How are plumbing and electrical rough-ins coordinated with framing and drywall?

mainEntity.name: How are plumbing and electrical rough-ins coordinated with framing and drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sub-trades for electrical and plumbing must be scheduled immediately after custom framing and before drywall installation begins. A general contractor builds the wall framing, then coordinates licensed plumbers to run supply and drain lines and electricians to set outlet boxes and wire circuits. All in-wall mechanical work must pass municipal rough-in inspections before insulation and drywall cover the studs. Managing this trade sequence tightly prevents work stoppages and ensures pipes and junction boxes are placed exactly where cabinets, vanities, or wall-hung fixtures are planned.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rough-in plumbing and electrical must be completed after custom framing and pass municipal inspections before drywall installation begins.
